ITEM 1 | Single triangular wedge with a thin, slightly blistered, golden-brown crust edge showing darker browned spots near the outer rim; crust roughly 1.5 cm thick at the edge, tapering to a thin base; piece spans about 11 cm long across the plate, sitting on a plain white square plate | 85
ITEM 2 | Red-orange tomato-based sauce spread thinly over the crust, glossy and moist in places, with bright orange patches and some darker reddish edges where it pools near the crust | 20
ITEM 3 | Soft, pale white cheese layer with patches of creamy white melted mozzarella-like texture, slightly bubbly and lightly browned in spots, covering the central portion of the wedge | 30
ITEM 4 | Scattered small diced pieces of pinkish-brown cured meat, roughly 0.5 to 1 cm cubes, with some darker caramelized edges and a slightly glossy sheen, distributed across the cheese and sauce | 15
ITEM 5 | A few tiny flecks of green herb leaves, about 0.3 cm each, sparsely scattered near the right edge of the wedge | 1
